disputes.reason_text: I never received this order. The tracking says it was delivered but nobody handed it to me and there was nothing at my door. I want the full amount back.
This was supposed to arrive two weeks ago and it is still not here. I have asked twice and nobody can tell me where it is, so I have raised it with my bank.
Two of the four chairs arrived with cracked legs. I sent photographs to support on the 20th of July and heard nothing back, so I am disputing the part I paid for those two.
